explanation: Implemented Apache Commons CSV 1.10.0 core parsing and printing algorithms faithfully into Python without external libraries. Handled full validation rules including delimiter/quote/escape conflicts, line break validations, QuoteMode behaviors (ALL, ALL_NON_NULL, MINIMAL, NON_NUMERIC, NONE), exact character tokenization with ExtendedBufferedReader lookaheads, nested record/trailing delimiter mechanics, and null_string transformations.
